title: Paul McCartney live: Estadio de La Peineta, Madrid | 2004
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Estadio de La Peineta in Madrid, Spain, on 30 May 2004.

It was the third show of the 04 Summer Tour, which lasted for 14 dates in May and June 2004.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).
